title: Pagecast: a CLI that publishes your agent's HTML output straight to a live Cloudflare Pages URL

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Your agent generates an HTML report or a static mini app and it just sits on your disk as a file nobody else can see. Pagecast publishes it instantly to a sharable Cloudflare pages URL straight from your terminal or coding agent. Cloud code builds a dashboard, runs one command, hands you a live link hosted free on Cloudflare's edge. No git push, no deploy pipeline, no dashboard dragging.
